purpose: Retained non-runtime authoring and parity fixture for the authoritative 95-exercise Batch 2 after approved duplicate removal. The canonical runtime source remains lib/exercise-library.ts, and runtime application code must not import or load this manifest.

authoringDecisions.manifestRole: Retained non-runtime authoring and parity fixture.
authoringDecisions.runtimeLoadPolicy: Runtime application code must not import or load this manifest.
authoringDecisions.videoPolicy: No URL is considered reviewed. All videoUrl values are null and must remain blank unless separately human-reviewed.
authoringDecisions.aliasPolicy: Do not create aliases automatically. Add only explicit, unambiguous aliases approved during implementation review.
authoringDecisions.collisionPolicy: Stop on canonical ID, normalized canonical name, or reviewed alias collision. Include user-owned normalized-name collisions.
authoringDecisions.databasePolicy: Generate a new additive, idempotent, system-only migration with exact TypeScript-to-SQL parity and read-only verification.

exercises.name: Heels-elevated goblet squat
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the heels supported, hold the weight close, and use a depth you can control.

exercises.name: Safety-bar squat
exercises.coachingNote: Brace before each rep, keep the handles steady, and drive up without letting the torso collapse.

exercises.name: Low-bar back squat
exercises.coachingNote: Set the bar securely across the rear shoulders, brace hard, and keep the bar over midfoot.

exercises.name: High-bar back squat
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the bar high on the upper back, brace, and sit between the hips with the knees tracking over the toes.

exercises.name: Paused barbell back squat
exercises.coachingNote: Pause under control at the bottom without relaxing, then drive up while maintaining your brace.

exercises.name: Tempo goblet squat
exercises.coachingNote: Lower for three seconds, stay balanced over the whole foot, and stand without bouncing.

exercises.name: Belt squat
exercises.coachingNote: Stay tall, keep the feet planted, and squat through a comfortable range without letting the knees cave.

exercises.name: Pendulum squat
exercises.coachingNote: Keep your back supported, lower smoothly, and drive through the platform without locking the knees forcefully.

exercises.name: Smith-machine squat
exercises.coachingNote: Set your feet so the fixed bar path feels balanced and use a controlled depth.

exercises.name: Landmine squat
exercises.coachingNote: Hold the bar close to the chest, sit down between the hips, and keep the whole foot grounded.

exercises.name: Supported sissy squat
exercises.coachingNote: Use support for balance, keep the hips extended, and only descend through a knee range that feels controlled.

exercises.name: Sumo deadlift
exercises.coachingNote: Set a comfortable wide stance, brace, and push the floor away while keeping the bar close.

exercises.name: Barbell rack pull
exercises.coachingNote: Start the bar below the knee, brace before pulling, and finish tall without leaning back.

exercises.name: Barbell block pull
exercises.coachingNote: Set the bar on stable blocks, keep it close, and stand by driving through the floor.

exercises.name: Deficit conventional deadlift
exercises.coachingNote: Use a small stable platform, keep the bar close, and stop if the added range disrupts your position.

exercises.name: Barbell good morning
exercises.coachingNote: Keep a soft knee bend, hinge the hips back, and stop before the torso position changes.

exercises.name: Cable pull-through
exercises.coachingNote: Step forward for tension, hinge back, and finish by extending the hips without leaning backward.

exercises.name: Two-hand kettlebell swing
exercises.coachingNote: Hike the bell back, snap the hips, and let the arms guide rather than lift the bell.

exercises.name: Single-leg dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the hips square, reach the free leg back, and stop when you can no longer control the pelvis.

exercises.name: Kickstand dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.coachingNote: Keep most of your weight on the front leg and use the rear foot only for balance.

exercises.name: Dumbbell hip thrust
exercises.coachingNote: Place the dumbbell securely across the hips, keep the ribs down, and pause at the top.

exercises.name: Single-leg hip thrust
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the pelvis level, drive through the working foot, and stop before the low back takes over.

exercises.name: Frog pump
exercises.coachingNote: Press the soles together, keep the ribs down, and squeeze the glutes without arching the back.

exercises.name: Nordic hamstring curl
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the hips extended and lower only as far as you can control before using the hands for assistance.

exercises.name: Slider leg curl
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the hips lifted, slide the heels away slowly, and pull them back without losing pelvic control.

exercises.name: Barbell reverse lunge
exercises.coachingNote: Step back softly, keep the front foot planted, and maintain a stable torso under the bar.

exercises.name: Front-foot-elevated split squat
exercises.coachingNote: Use a low platform, keep the front foot grounded, and descend only through a range you can control.

exercises.name: Barbell split squat
exercises.coachingNote: Set a stable split stance, lower straight down, and keep the front knee tracking over the foot.

exercises.name: Smith-machine split squat
exercises.coachingNote: Position the feet for a balanced fixed bar path and lower under control.

exercises.name: Lateral step-down
exercises.coachingNote: Lower the free heel toward the floor while keeping the stance knee aligned over the foot.

exercises.name: Single-leg leg press
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the hips supported and press through a controlled range without locking the knee forcefully.

exercises.name: Cable reverse lunge
exercises.coachingNote: Hold the cable close, step back under control, and drive through the front foot.

exercises.name: Landmine reverse lunge
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the landmine close to the chest, step back softly, and stay balanced over the front foot.

exercises.name: Lateral step-up
exercises.coachingNote: Stand beside a low step, drive through the elevated foot, and control the descent.

exercises.name: Pistol squat to box
exercises.coachingNote: Reach the hips toward a high box, keep the stance foot grounded, and use a height that preserves control.

exercises.name: Decline barbell bench press
exercises.coachingNote: Secure the legs, lower the bar toward the lower chest with control, and press evenly.

exercises.name: Decline dumbbell bench press
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the shoulders set, lower the dumbbells through a comfortable range, and press smoothly.

exercises.name: Neutral-grip dumbbell bench press
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the palms facing each other, elbows close to the torso, and lower with control.

exercises.name: Alternating dumbbell bench press
exercises.coachingNote: Hold one dumbbell steady while pressing the other and keep the torso from rotating.

exercises.name: Paused barbell bench press
exercises.coachingNote: Pause the bar lightly on the chest without relaxing, then press while maintaining your setup.

exercises.name: Tempo push-up
exercises.coachingNote: Lower for three seconds, keep a straight body line, and press without losing trunk position.

exercises.name: Deficit push-up
exercises.coachingNote: Use stable handles, lower only through a comfortable shoulder range, and keep the body rigid.

exercises.name: Diamond push-up
exercises.coachingNote: Place the hands close without forcing the wrists, keep the elbows controlled, and maintain a strong plank.

exercises.name: Ring push-up
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the rings steady, maintain a rigid body line, and use a height that allows controlled reps.

exercises.name: Pike push-up
exercises.coachingNote: Lift the hips, lower the head between the hands, and press without letting the elbows flare excessively.

exercises.name: Wall-assisted handstand push-up
exercises.coachingNote: Use the wall for balance, lower through a controlled range, and stop before the neck or shoulder position changes.

exercises.name: Standing two-hand landmine press
exercises.coachingNote: Hold the bar near the chest, brace, and press up and forward without leaning back.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling single-arm landmine press
exercises.coachingNote: Squeeze the down-side glute, keep the ribs stacked, and press the bar without rotating.

exercises.name: Arnold press
exercises.coachingNote: Rotate smoothly as you press and use a range that keeps the shoulder comfortable.

exercises.name: Machine shoulder press
exercises.coachingNote: Set the seat so the handles begin near shoulder height and press without shrugging.

exercises.name: Single-arm cable chest press
exercises.coachingNote: Stand in a stable split stance, press straight ahead, and resist torso rotation.

exercises.name: Neutral-grip pull-up
exercises.coachingNote: Start from a controlled hang, pull the chest toward the handles, and lower without swinging.

exercises.name: Wide-grip pull-up
exercises.coachingNote: Use only a moderately wide grip, pull without kipping, and stop before the shoulder position becomes uncomfortable.

exercises.name: Eccentric pull-up
exercises.coachingNote: Step to the top position and lower for three to five seconds without dropping.

exercises.name: Straight-arm cable pulldown
exercises.coachingNote: Keep a soft elbow bend, pull the bar toward the thighs, and avoid leaning to create momentum.

exercises.name: Single-arm lat pulldown
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the torso tall, pull the elbow toward the hip, and control the return.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling lat pulldown
exercises.coachingNote: Stay tall in the half-kneeling stance and pull without arching the low back.

exercises.name: Close-grip neutral lat pulldown
exercises.coachingNote: Pull the handle toward the upper chest and keep the torso from rocking.

exercises.name: Machine high row
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the chest supported and drive the elbows down and back without shrugging.

exercises.name: Barbell seal row
exercises.coachingNote: Lie securely on the bench, row the bar toward the lower chest, and lower without bouncing.

exercises.name: Single-arm seated cable row
exercises.coachingNote: Sit tall, pull the handle toward the ribs, and resist rotating the torso.

exercises.name: Meadows row
exercises.coachingNote: Brace the free hand, keep the torso stable, and row the bar end toward the hip.

exercises.name: Ring row
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the rings steady, maintain a straight body line, and pull the hands toward the ribs.

exercises.name: Cable rear-delt row
exercises.coachingNote: Pull the rope toward the upper chest with the elbows out and keep the shoulders relaxed.

exercises.name: Dumbbell pullover
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the ribs controlled, lower the dumbbell only through a comfortable shoulder range, and pull it back over the chest.

exercises.name: Machine pullover
exercises.coachingNote: Set the seat for a comfortable shoulder path and drive the pads down without arching the back.

exercises.name: EZ-bar preacher curl
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the upper arms supported, curl without lifting the shoulders, and lower under control.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell curl
exercises.coachingNote: Let the arms hang naturally, keep the shoulders back, and curl without moving the upper arms.

exercises.name: Concentration curl
exercises.coachingNote: Brace the upper arm against the inner thigh and curl without swinging.

exercises.name: Standing cable curl
exercises.coachingNote: Stand tall, keep the elbows near the sides, and curl through a controlled range.

exercises.name: EZ-bar reverse curl
exercises.coachingNote: Use an overhand grip, keep the wrists neutral, and curl without swinging.

exercises.name: Dumbbell spider curl
exercises.coachingNote: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, keep the upper arms still, and curl smoothly.

exercises.name: Bayesian cable curl
exercises.coachingNote: Stand slightly ahead of the cable, keep the upper arm behind the torso, and curl without moving the shoulder.

exercises.name: Bench dip
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the hips close to the bench and use only a shoulder range that feels comfortable.

exercises.name: EZ-bar skull crusher
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the upper arms steady, lower the bar behind the forehead, and extend the elbows smoothly.

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell overhead triceps extension
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the ribs down, point the elbows forward, and use a comfortable overhead range.

exercises.name: Single-arm cable triceps kickback
exercises.coachingNote: Hinge slightly, keep the upper arm still, and extend the elbow without rotating the torso.

exercises.name: Dumbbell front raise
exercises.coachingNote: Raise the dumbbells only to a comfortable height and lower without swinging.

exercises.name: Rear-delt machine fly
exercises.coachingNote: Set the seat so the handles align with the shoulders and open the arms without shrugging.

exercises.name: Cable upright row
exercises.coachingNote: Use a rope or comfortable grip, pull only to a pain-free height, and keep the shoulders relaxed.

exercises.name: RKC plank
exercises.coachingNote: Squeeze the glutes, pull the elbows toward the toes, and keep a straight line without holding your breath.

exercises.name: Long-lever plank
exercises.coachingNote: Place the elbows slightly ahead of the shoulders and hold without letting the low back sag.

exercises.name: Hollow-body hold
exercises.coachingNote: Press the low back gently into the floor and shorten the lever if you cannot maintain contact.

exercises.name: Bear plank
exercises.coachingNote: Hover the knees just above the floor, keep the back flat, and breathe without shifting.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling Pallof press
exercises.coachingNote: Squeeze the down-side glute, keep the ribs stacked, and press without rotating.

exercises.name: Standing cable chop
exercises.coachingNote: Rotate through the upper body and hips together while keeping the movement controlled.

exercises.name: Single-arm overhead carry
exercises.coachingNote: Lock the weight in a stable overhead position, keep the ribs down, and walk without leaning.

exercises.name: Dead bug with dumbbell pullover
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the low back anchored while moving the dumbbell overhead only as far as you can control.

exercises.name: Single-leg calf raise
exercises.coachingNote: Use support for balance, rise fully through the ball of the foot, and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Standing machine calf raise
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the knees softly extended, rise under control, and pause before lowering.

exercises.name: Donkey calf raise
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the hips supported, move through the ankle, and control the stretch at the bottom.

exercises.name: Seated tibialis raise
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the heels planted and lift the toes toward the shins without bouncing.

exercises.name: Box jump
exercises.coachingNote: Choose a box you can land on softly, jump with intent, and step down between reps.

exercises.name: Standing broad jump
exercises.coachingNote: Swing the arms, jump forward with intent, and land softly with the knees tracking over the feet.

exercises.name: Sled push
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the torso braced, drive through the ground with short steps, and maintain steady pressure into the sled.
